Trading Card Game?
Welcome to the world of Free Realms and the Free Realms Trading Card Game (TCG). Over the next few pages, you'll find an explanation of the game itself, as well as how to run a Free Realms TCG tournament. The example is meant to provide guidelines for your activity. Feel free to improvise and design a scenario that works for your particular kids and your camp. The goal is to have fun!
The enclosed Free Realms TCG playmat has two sides. The Quick Rules side contains everything you need to start playing right away and provides spaces to place your cards, deck, discard pile, inventory and more!
The second side adds more detail, definitions and other cool information about the Free Realms Trading Card Game. Have the campers (and you!) spend some time becoming familiar with the playmat before starting the game.
The Free Realms Trading Card Game can be found at major retailers like Target, Toys R Us, and Best Buy.
Also, check your local hobby/retail game store for products, as well as any organized events.
For more information, please see:
www.FreeRealms.com/TCGhome.vm

pages: Free Realms: Trading Card Game Program Overview
text:
PLAYING:
Each matched pair should be given 20 minutes to play 1 game. If there are games still in progress when you call time, let the active player finish his turn, and award the game to the player who is ahead in scoring.
SCORING:
Keep track of the win-loss records for each player. Rank the best record starting from most wins (1st place) to least wins (last place). A score card has been included for your convenience.
If there is a tie, you can have players with the same record play a single match to determine the winner.
NEED TO FILL UP MORE TIME?
Switch from a single game per match to a best-of-three format.
PRIZES:
Use the booster packs as prizes for your tournament.
• 1st place – Two booster packs
• 2nd place – One booster pack
• 3rd place – One booster pack
• Good Sportsmanship Award – One booster pack

text:
Organized Activities
ROUND ROBIN TOURNAMENT
The Round Robin format is a "fun for all" play style designed for 4 to 10 players. The tournament should last between 1 and 2 hours. The best part of a Round Robin event is that nobody is eliminated from play! Larger groups can be accommodated by creating multiple groups of 4 to 10 members.
HOW TO RUN A ROUND ROBIN TOURNAMENT:
Count off each player, out loud, starting at #1. Sit the player with the lowest number across from the player with the highest number as in the Round 1 example below.
At the end of each round, have each player play a new opponent (someone he or she hasn't played before), or refer to the Round 2, 3 & 4 examples below.
ROUND 1
Player 1 plays 8
2 plays 7
3 plays 6
4 plays 5
ROUND 2

2 plays 8
3 plays 7
4 plays 6

pages: Free Realms: Trading Card Game Program Overview
text:
Letter to the Director
Dear Camp Director:
We are really excited to share with you the amazing world of Free Realms!
Free Realms is an online virtual world that is free to play for kids and families. It is a safe and engaging game world that has adventure, pet training, optional combat, kart racing, demolition derby, cooking games and so much more. One of the most popular and fun parts of the online virtual world is a trading card game. The pages in this booklet will explain to you in more detail about the game and the program that has been designed specifically for camps! The trading card game is able to be played online in a digital version, as well as in a physical format that is available in retail stores.
This program will focus on the physical trading card game and organized play activities. As you know, trading card games are very popular kids, and this will provide an easy but fun play activity for the campers. At the end of the program, you may be asked to pass out a survey for the campers to complete that will help gauge the success of the program. We appreciate your participation in advance!
Have fun!
What Is Free Realms?
KEY FEATURES
- Play Free or Upgrade: Free to play, or purchase a monthly membership for only $4.99 USD. A variety of items are available through the online SOE Station Marketplace.
- Rich Character Creation: More than 30,000 wearable combinations to create your perfect avatar.
- Be Whoever You Want: With nine free jobs and five Members-Only Jobs to choose from, you can pick your favorite or try them all!
- Kid Safe: Parental controls allow for the customization of safety options, including pre-canned chat, reporting and filters for younger players.
- Fun for Everyone: 14 different styles of minigames and more than 550 quests for everyone. More than 400 additional quests are available to Members.
- Vibrant, Deep Environment: Eight distinct, breathtaking environments for gamers to explore.
- Connect with Friends: Old and new friends can stay connected through Free Realms' social networking page.
- Trading Card Game: Collect cards to arm yourself with the best attacks and defenses for fun, fast-paced combat.
GENRE: Online Role-Playing Game
ESRB: E 10+ for Crude Humor and Fantasy Violence
DEVELOPER/PUBLISHER: Sony Online Entertainment LLC
PLATFORM: PC
